domain: origami rigid foldability and single-vertex kinematics
limitations: The retained claim is tangent-space only at the fully flat-folded state: a strictly positive kernel vector is a necessary first-order condition, not a proof of a finite rigid-unfolding branch. The minimum forcing number 5 for equal-angle n=8 flat-foldable SVCPs is prior Ouchi–Uehara theory and is retained only as a reproduction check.
provenance: Previously published finding; fresh scientific audit completed on 2026-10-01 UTC.
record_title: First-order flat-state rigid-unfolding parity criterion for the equiangular degree-8 vertex
